# Install locations

<!-- Generated by `node packages/cli build` from the harness registry. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every coding agent below loads the same skill folder (a folder with a `SKILL.md`). Copy the finished skill folder to the project path to scope it to one repository, or to the user path to make it available in every project, then restart the agent session.

| Agent | Project path | User path | Path source | Docs |
|-------|--------------|-----------|-------------|------|
| Cursor / Cursor CLI | `.cursor/skills/<skill-name>/` | `~/.cursor/skills/<skill-name>/` | official | [docs](https://cursor.com/docs/skills) |
| Claude / Claude Code | `.claude/skills/<skill-name>/` | `~/.claude/skills/<skill-name>/` | official | [docs](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) |
| Antigravity | `.agents/skills/<skill-name>/` | `~/.gemini/antigravity/skills/<skill-name>/` | official | [docs](https://antigravity.google/docs/skills) |
| OpenCode | `.opencode/skills/<skill-name>/` | `~/.config/opencode/skills/<skill-name>/` | official | [docs](https://opencode.ai/docs/skills/) |
| Cline | `.cline/skills/<skill-name>/` | `~/.cline/skills/<skill-name>/` | official | [docs](https://docs.cline.bot/customization/skills) |
| Kilo Code | `.kilocode/skills/<skill-name>/` | `~/.kilocode/skills/<skill-name>/` | official | [docs](https://kilo.ai/docs/customize/skills) |
| Kiro | `.kiro/skills/<skill-name>/` | `~/.kiro/skills/<skill-name>/` | official | [docs](https://kiro.dev/docs/skills/) |
| Codex | `.agents/skills/<skill-name>/` | `~/.agents/skills/<skill-name>/` | community | [docs](https://developers.openai.com/codex/skills) |
| GitHub Copilot | `.github/skills/<skill-name>/` | `~/.copilot/skills/<skill-name>/` | official | [docs](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/how-tos/use-copilot-agents/cloud-agent/create-skills) |
| Muse Code | `.agents/skills/<skill-name>/` | `~/.agents/skills/<skill-name>/` | community | [docs](https://www.withone.ai/blog/muse-code-skills-not-mcp) |

`<skill-name>` is the folder name and must equal the `name` in the frontmatter.

## Notes per agent

- **Cursor / Cursor CLI:** Cursor CLI reads the same folders. Cursor also loads .agents/skills, .claude/skills, and .codex/skills.
- **Claude / Claude Code:** Nested .claude/skills folders inside subdirectories also load when working there.
- **Antigravity:** Older versions use .agent/skills. Antigravity 2.0 documents ~/.gemini/config/skills for user scope; the IDE and codelab use ~/.gemini/antigravity/skills.
- **OpenCode:** OpenCode also reads .claude/skills and .agents/skills.
- **Cline:** The name field must match the folder name exactly.
- **Kilo Code:** Folders named skills-<mode>, such as skills-code, load only in that mode.
- **Kiro:** Workspace skills take priority over user skills with the same name.
- **Codex:** Scan paths come from community guides; /etc/codex/skills is the admin location. Codex configuration lives in ~/.codex.
- **GitHub Copilot:** Copilot also reads .claude/skills and .agents/skills. Works in VS Code agent mode, Copilot CLI, and the cloud agent.
- **Muse Code:** Based on one community report: muse skills list scans ~/.agents/skills, ~/.claude/skills, and ~/.codex/skills.

## Copy commands

macOS and Linux, Claude Code at project scope:

```bash
mkdir -p .claude/skills
cp -r ./skills/<skill-name> .claude/skills/
```

Windows PowerShell, Claude Code at user scope:

```powershell
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$env:USERPROFILE\.claude\skills" | Out-Null
Copy-Item -Recurse .\skills\<skill-name> "$env:USERPROFILE\.claude\skills\"
```

Paths marked `community` come from community reports and should be confirmed in the agent before relying on them.
